column2: Fixed Asset register as of cutover date. Net_Book_Value = Original_Cost minus Accumulated_Depreciation. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py fixed_assets this_file.csv 3
Asset_Class: Must match a valid Workday Asset Class Reference ID configured in your tenant (e.g. TECHNOLOGY / VEHICLES / FURNITURE / BUILDINGS)
Depreciation_Method valid values: Straight_Line | Declining_Balance_150 | Declining_Balance_200 | Sum_of_Years_Digits | Units_of_Production | No_Depreciation
Accumulated_Depreciation: Cumulative depreciation from inception to cutover date. Original_Cost - Accumulated_Depreciation = Net_Book_Value
Useful_Life_Years: Remaining useful life is NOT what goes here — enter TOTAL useful life (e.g., 3 years for a laptop, not remaining years)
Asset_Status valid values: Active | Retired | Fully_Depreciated
Retirement_Date: Only populate for Retired assets. Leave blank for Active and Fully_Depreciated assets
Reconciliation check: Sum of Original_Cost = Fixed Asset cost per legacy trial balance. Sum of Net_Book_Value = Net Fixed Assets per legacy balance sheet
Load order: Object 7 — can be loaded after Company and Cost Center setup, independent of AP/AR loads
